🔒 PRIVACY & DATA SOVEREIGNTY

Zero Telemetry & Tracking: This application contains no tracking scripts, no third-party analytic beacons, and no behavioral surveillance.

100% Local Storage: Your card collection inventory, custom decks, and preferences are stored exclusively on your device using local storage. Your data never leaves your hardware.

Local Camera Processing: Camera card scanning and OCR operate 100% client-side via on-device browser canvas and Tesseract worker logic. No video frames or images are ever uploaded or transmitted across the network.
